column11: COST: New York City Parks Department, average cost to plant one street tree in Fiscal Year 2024 = USD 3300, inclusive of site survey, sidewalk/stump work, nursery stock and two years of contractor maintenance (reported in Crain's New York Business, C. Spivak, 2024; summarised at https://forestforall.nyc/costs-city-plant-tree-why/). Maintenance is entered as 0 because the two-year maintenance contract is already inside the capital figure. NYC is a high-cost jurisdiction; substitute a local figure before using this outside New York. EFFECT: Locke DH, Baker M, Alonzo M, et al. Variation in the relationship between urban tree canopy and air temperature reduction under a range of daily weather conditions. Heliyon 2024;10(3):e25041. doi:10.1016/j.heliyon.2024.e25041. Reported air-temperature reductions associated with canopy cover range from -0.51 C (cloudy afternoon) to -1.78 C (clear afternoon, hottest quartile of days). ASSUMPTION: that range is measured against a large canopy-cover difference, not per tree, so applying it here assumes the per-block planting quantity achieves a substantial canopy increase on the treated block. Predictions are clamped to this range, and the range is the interval shown to the user.
